snippet.title: Farm & Feast - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Grow fresh ingredients and run your own little restaurant. Enjoy a peaceful day that stretches from the field to the table. Plan a fresh menu for a delightful day, keep your pantry full, and make your customers happy. Earn your own money and build your little world step by step.


Wishlist Now:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/4521650/Farm__Feast/
Join Discord: https://discord.gg/5G3GknzwG
